A2.reason: C7 requires the promotion to still be reversible when the release is asked for, after the worker has tidied the staging area. The A1 rehearsal cannot show this because it ran before the promotion and the tidy.

C9.for_what_part: Shown for the sending calls in the record as of the time the answer is taken: recipients and wording against the release, and which calls are confirmed. Calls ordered and not confirmed stay in doubt. A confirmed call does not show whether it sent or only previewed.

parsed.what_i_would_have_wanted_and_the_library:
1. An instrument that checks each case's category against the requester's rule (C3). None exists in the library.
2. A plan-level check on the worker's reads (C5). Scope of a call can only be asked for during the work, at 10 per line. With 101 reads and an allowance of 50, I can only sample about five of them at A1.
3. An outbox check for every sending call (C10). Trace of a call is only available on named lines at A3, at 10 per line, so 100 calls cannot be covered. A confirmed preview looks the same in the record as a confirmed send.
4. An answer that ties the live tables to the staged set directly. Same set and summary of the change read only the staged set as it was kept, so this link rests on the promotion's line in the record (fp_in and fp_out).
